title: Constant completion coefficient objects and scalar-extension data
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $A$ be a commutative ring, and let $I\subset A$ be an ideal. Write $\underline R$ for the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Define $S_n=\underline{A/I^{n+1}}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, with the quotient transition maps, and $B=\varprojlim_n S_n$ [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Let $\pi_n:B\to S_n$ be its limit projections and $\eta:\underline A\to B$ the limit lift of the quotient maps. For any commutative ring sheaf $\mathcal O$, write $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ for its module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\operatorname{Cx}(\mathcal O)$ for its integer-indexed cochain complexes, and $Q_{\mathcal O}:\operatorname{Cx}(\mathcal O)\to D(\mathcal O)$ for the standard derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a ring-sheaf map $\varphi:R\to S$, let $\operatorname{change}_\varphi:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ be ordinary sheafified scalar extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Its tensor-section insertion sends local sections $s\in S(U)$ and $m\in M(U)$ to the image of $s\otimes m$ under the sheafification unit. Define $\operatorname{DerivedExtension}(\varphi)$ to be the data of a functor $F:D(R)\to D(S)$ and a natural comparison $\epsilon:Q_R F\to\operatorname{change}_\varphi^{\mathrm{Cx}}Q_S$ making $F$ a left derived functor and with $\epsilon_P$ invertible for every K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Choose this universally specified derived pair supplied by [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], determined up to its unique comparison-preserving natural isomorphism, and denote its functor and comparison by $\operatorname{extend}_\varphi$ and $\operatorname{extendComparison}_\varphi$. These are coefficient constructions and their universal comparison data; no flatness, quotient identification or completeness assertion is imposed.
